# R5.34 — Account refusal, exhaustion and operational reporting machinery

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/204_R5.34__operations.md` (seq 204/246) · §5.2/§5.3 of
`docs/evidence-and-adoption-spec.md` (s5 O6/O7 cells, counts and limits) ·
**Requirement ids:** none primary — contributing-only slice ·
**Landing record:** ADR-0412

## Summary

Lands the §5.2/D3-F4 **Account refusal and exhaustion cells** plus the
§5.3/D3-F5 **fixed 8×3 stage-count report machinery** — the third packet of
the read-only `ops` instrument (ADR-0410/ADR-0411 confinement unchanged —
no RPC, schema, production dependency or event-class admission).
`crates/hh-env/src/ops.rs` gains the closed 19-member `AccountFailure`
set + `AccountOutcome` with the pure `o6_outcome`/`o7_outcome` folds:
O6 requires the identical O1 positive path demonstrated, the starved
`model_calls` reserve durably refused, **zero** independently counted
transport entries on the refused call, no dependent mutation and no
terminal-exhaustion spelling (a refusal is not exhaustion); O7 requires
a committed fact behind a declared bounded barrier (bound + observation
interval + fail-safe before execution, grace = 0), expiry-before-commit
checked **first** as the unreachable precondition, a durable-origin
deadline actually reached by real `time.wall_ms`, new dispatch blocked,
drain to released/unknown, `exceeded`+`stop` landed, no later marker,
no duplicate charge and committed work preserved on rebuild. The report
machinery — `OpsCell`/`OPS_CELLS`, frozen seeded 8×3 = 24-trial
permutation (balanced blocks, dependency-free splitmix64), retained
`TrialOutcome` kinds, append-only `TrialRecord`s refusing
`ReplacedOriginal`, ≤1 new-identity setup diagnostic rerun per cell,
ppm `stage_ratio` with zero-denominator `undefined`, the
`[V/P,(V+U)/P]` planned-slot missingness bound (a bound, never a
confidence interval), O8 `detected/3` reported separately, failed
negative control / integrity breach → acceptance blocked / immediate
stop — renders `ops_report/1`. `tests/r5_34.rs` (7/7) drives the
**real** Store/WAL, `ManualClock`, real `Account` (root + instrument
budgets), the landed `prepared` path behind a counting diagnostic
`Transport` and `MarkerSink`/`Sentinel`/`OpsObserver`: O6
zero-model_calls refusal before transport, O7 wall-expiry
drain-then-stop with rebuild/reopen preservation and dedup, both
negative matrices, expiry-before-commit unreachable, report
counts/bounds/O8/replaced-original/excess-retry/failed-control legs.
Predecessor contracts consumed unchanged; $0 spend; offline only.

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**1,851 changed source/test lines vs the ≤800 trigger (~2.3×)** —
recorded Deviation, accepted per the scoped AMEND ruling
`18189fb1` (`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.34-split-review.md`):
the O3 partition packet binds the O6/O7 cells + fixed 8×3 seeded
permutation + reporting to one owner working set in one scope
sentence (the packet family writes contingencies verbatim where
intended — X7/M-A/E-207 carry them; O3 none); L150's four weak
seams are consumed or other tickets' boundaries. The report
machinery is **the cells' own fold** — `OpsReport` enumerates
`OPS_CELLS` and folds their `TrialRecord`s into the §5.3
acceptance surface (same one-owner-interface shape as R5.23's
`assemble_receipt`), not a separable unit. The proposed
apparatus-vs-battery cut is the R5.32-rejected impl-vs-battery
split in the strict form: ops.rs has zero `#[cfg(test)]` — leg (a)
lands an instrument exercised by nothing, leg (b) IS the evidence
— and leg (b) alone ~1,163 still crosses the trigger
(non-curative). Honest trip: review, not redesign.
